svg.title: Index Translator browser components, files and history
svg.desc: The page's main module saves finished translations in the history and lists them through the history panel. History is kept in local storage only. The Open control reads a text, PDF or image file in the browser. A PDF goes to a worker that reads its text page by page, and the messages module tells the user what was loaded. Text and PDF never go to the server; an opened image goes only when it is translated. save history: public/app.ts → public/history.ts → public/storage.ts. open a PDF: public/app.ts → public/open-ui.ts → public/pdf.ts → public/pdf-worker.ts.

g.text: reads text and image, file kinds
